# MRT Mauritania: found (homicide by wilaya, 2022–2025)

Source: ANSADE "Annuaire des Statistiques Sociodémographiques 2025", Tableau 4.7. It gives the count and the rate per 100,000 for 13 wilayas plus a national total ("Enssemble", as printed), 2022–2025. Each year's wilaya counts sum to the national total. The public site ansade.mr is a JavaScript app (plain direct download got 406). The PDF list came from the backend WordPress media data service at admin.ansade.mr.

Oddities, kept as published:
- Tableau 4.7 cites its source as "Ministère de la Justice / Direction de Prison". The national Tableau 4.9, with the same totals 2022–2025, cites the "Direction Générale de la Sûreté Nationale". It is unclear which is right; it is probably DGSN police data.
- Nouakchott's 2024 rate cell is blank, so it is left blank. Counts are printed with decimals ("18.00") and were stored as integers.
- Nouakchott is one wilaya in the table. The three Nouakchott wilayas (Nord/Ouest/Sud) are not split.
- Area names are as printed ("lnchiri" with a lowercase L, "D. Nouadhibou").
- The national 2021 figure (32; rate 0.74) is only in Tableau 4.9.

Also opened:
- "Annuaire Statistique 2020-2021" (https://admin.ansade.mr/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Annuaire_Statistique-2020-2021.pdf). Tableau 6.6 "Nombre d'infractions enregistrées et personnes déférées par la police judiciaire de Nouakchott … 2020" lists Meurtre, Assassinat, Homicide involontaire and Découverte de cadavre, but every number cell is empty in the published PDF (checked by rendering p. 81). Tableau 6.5 gives convictions by the Nouakchott courts; its numbers are also not in the text layer. Nothing was entered from it.
- Other annuaires in the list (2015, 2016, 2022, Économiques, Socio-démographique 2023/2024) were not opened. The 2023 and 2024 socio-demographic editions may carry earlier years of Tableau 4.7.
- No licence statement.
